SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.QCNAME, C.MONITORTMPLNAME, O.ORGNAME, D.TESTMETHODID, D.ITEMNAME, F.TESTNAME, G.METHODNAME FROM T_EMC_ITEM_QCINDEX A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_QC_CATEGORY B ON A.QCCATEGORYID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL C ON A.MONITORTMPLID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG O ON A.ORGID = O.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM D ON A.ITEMID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD E ON D.TESTMETHODID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST F ON E.TESTID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD G ON E.METHODID = G.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
